methodology.formula: exp(log(DD baseline) + sum(weight × clamp(log(source rank / baseline), -log(2), log(2))))
methodology.unlistedDD: 501 is a censored boundary, not an asserted DD rank; requires another ranked source. Otherwise review queue.
methodology.missingSupport: Neutral. Weight never redistributed. Missing ranks never imply graduation.
methodology.eligibility: User instruction: non-debuted prospects only. Any recorded MLB debut excludes the player, regardless of remaining rookie eligibility. Inspect every roster slot; retain additional MLB eligibility checks.
methodology.movement: August-to-October movement mixes graduation, ownership changes, source coverage and a changed model. Org arrows only when organization identity is unchanged.
methodology.limits: Working consensus, not a finished independent scouting reassessment. Eligible players lacking verified current rank evidence remain in review queue. BA partially accessible. No fabricated farm grades, scouting reports or performance metrics.

sources.name: Dynasty Dugout
sources.context: User-supplied TSV. Publication date not supplied. 500 unique Fantrax IDs validated.

sources.name: Pitcher List
sources.context: Non-debuted list. Debut omission is neutral; not graduation.

sources.name: FanGraphs
sources.context: Older scouting baseline. Missing entries neutral.

sources.name: Just Baseball
sources.context: Scouting rather than dynasty ranks. Levels and ETA are dated observations.

sources.name: Baseball America
sources.context: Only publicly indexed ranks 1–36 verified; remaining entries unavailable. Absence neutral.

sources.name: MLB official player records and career statistics
sources.context: MLBAM identities, debut dates, regular-season career at-bats and pitching outs.

sources.name: TJStats service tracker
sources.context: Third-party calculated active MLB days matched by MLBAM ID. Current roster Yes/No is not eligibility.
